name: admin_workspace
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk workspace — the top-level container that groups personas, scopes, a quota, and configuration for a team or tenant.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Unique name of the workspace. The server stores the name in lowercase, so supply a lowercase value to avoid configuration drift. Changing the name forces a new resource.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Short identifier used as a prefix for tickets. Up to 10 characters, must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores. Must be unique across workspaces; when omitted, one is derived from the name.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Contact email address for the workspace. Must be a valid email address when set.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role label associated with the workspace.

attributes.name: team
attributes.description: Team label associated with the workspace.

attributes.name: prompt_md
attributes.description: Markdown system prompt applied to interactions within this workspace.

attributes.name: analytics_id
attributes.description: ID of an analytics record associated with this workspace.

attributes.name: quota_id
attributes.description: ID of the quota definition that limits this workspace's usage.

attributes.name: meta_data
attributes.description: Free-form key/value metadata associated with the workspace.

attributes.name: persona_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the personas available in this workspace. Provide the complete set; on update the full list replaces the previous one.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the scopes you manage on this workspace. Scopes the backend attaches automatically (for example a Kubernetes scope created with a cluster) are not included here — they appear in system_scope_ids and are preserved across updates.

attributes.name: system_scope_ids
attributes.description: IDs of scopes attached to this workspace by the backend (not managed in Terraform configuration), e.g. a Kubernetes scope created when a cluster is provisioned.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the workspace was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the workspace was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
